proposedEntry.name: usability-testing
proposedEntry.description: Plans and runs usability tests with real people: writes 3-5 task scenarios with realistic triggers and clear success conditions (never revealing how to complete them), sets participant recruitment targets (5-8 people, with explicit minimums covering screen-reader users, older adults, non-native speakers, and low tech confidence), selects a test method (moderated think-aloud, unmoderated remote, guerrilla, or accessibility audit with assistive-technology users) against a when-to-use table, structures the test script (welcome, background, tasks, debrief), classifies each task outcome (completed easily / with difficulty / failed / completed wrong) with a three-tier severity scale, and converts every finding into a concrete design action. Delivers a task-success-rate table, severity-ranked findings, and an iterate/ship/rethink recommendation.
triggers: how many participants do I need for testing
turn usability findings into design fixes
inputs: A working prototype or build to test
The core tasks/jobs from the design brief
outputs: Task scenarios and a full test script
Task success-rate table classified by outcome
